Layout primitives

Purpose: compose interfaces from a small set of content-first

Purpose: compose interfaces from a small set of content-first primitives. Primitives position; utilities fine-tune; components fill. If a layout needs a new primitive, it probably needs restructuring.

The set

PrimitiveRuleUse
.sq-container (+ --narrow, --wide)Centered, capped width, breathing guttersPage content
.sq-sectionGenerous vertical rhythm (section token)Major page sections; pages scroll
.sq-stack (+ --tight, --loose)Even vertical gaps between flow childrenAny stacked content
.sq-clusterWrapping row with real gapsButtons, chips, meta rows — never collides
.sq-splitWrapping row, space-betweenHeader rows, footers, label/value lines
.sq-grid-autoIntrinsic responsive grid (no breakpoint math)Card listings
.sq-divider (+ --vertical, --spacious)Token-spaced separatorBetween sections or inline groups

Composition patterns

Page: sq-section > sq-container > sq-stack--loose. Header row: sq-split (title left, actions right — wraps on narrow). Card grid: sq-grid-auto, or explicit sq-grid sq-grid-cols-* with responsive prefixes for exact column counts. Form: sq-panel > sq-stack > sq-field* (fields own their labels, help, and errors; see Stage 4 for full form behavior).

<section class="sq-section">
  <div class="sq-container sq-stack--loose sq-stack">
    <div class="sq-split">
      <h2 class="sq-heading--2">Projects</h2>
      <div class="sq-cluster">
        <button class="sq-button sq-button--secondary" type="button">
          Filter
        </button>
        <button class="sq-button sq-button--primary" type="button">New</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sq-grid-auto">
      <article class="sq-card">…</article>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

Rules

  • Sections grow; pages scroll. Never cap heights to "fit the viewport".
  • Narrow viewports stack (flex-col, single column) — never squeeze.
  • sq-cluster/sq-split wrap by default; controls keep ≥13px gaps.
  • Dividers separate; they never decorate. One per boundary.
  • Vertical dividers stretch (align-self: stretch) and are

aria-hidden="true" when purely visual between labeled groups.

Responsive notes

Primitives are fluid by construction. Add responsive utilities (sq-md-flex-row, sq-lg-grid-cols-3) only for deliberate breakpoints, documented in UTILITIES.md. Overflow utilities (sq-overflow-x-auto) handle wide tables/code — never the page itself.

Common mistakes

  • New wrapper classes per page (project-list, dashboard-grid) when

sq-grid-auto or sq-stack already compose.

  • Fixed heights on content regions — content decides height.
  • sq-split for three balanced columns — that's a grid.

Tested limitations

  • No masonry/source-order-independent layouts (write page CSS).
  • sq-grid-auto tiles never shrink below --sq-layout-tile-min (18rem

default); narrower tiles need an explicit grid or a token override.
